pairs: Commendo autem vobis Phœben sororem nostram,
Now I commend to you our sister Phoebe,
who is in the ministry of the church,
ut eam suscipiatis in Domino digne sanctis:
so that you may receive her in the Lord with the worthiness of the saints,
et assistatis ei in quocumque negotio vestri indiguerit:
and so that you may be of assistance to her in whatever task she will have need of you.
For she herself has also assisted many,
(qui pro anima mea suas cervices supposuerunt:
who have risked their own necks on behalf of my life,
quibus non solus ego gratias ago,
but also all the churches of the Gentiles;
and greet the church at their house.
qui est primitivus Asiæ in Christo.
who is among the first-fruits of Asia in Christ.
who has labored much among you.
who are noble among the Apostles,
qui et ante me fuerunt in Christo.
and who were in Christ prior to me.
Salutate Ampliatum dilectissimum mihi in Domino.
Greet Ampliatus, most beloved to me in the Lord.
Salutate Urbanum adjutorem nostrum in Christo Jesu,
Greet Urbanus, our helper in Christ Jesus,
Greet Apelles, who has been tested in Christ.
Salutate eos qui sunt ex Aristoboli domo.
Greet those who are from the household of Aristobulus.
Salutate eos qui sunt ex Narcisi domo,
Greet those who are of the household of Narcissus,
who has labored much in the Lord.
et qui cum eis sunt, fratres.
and the brothers who are with them.
et omnes qui cum eis sunt,
and all the saints who are with them.
Greet one another with a holy kiss.
All the churches of Christ greet you.
ut observetis eos qui dissensiones et offendicula, præter doctrinam, quam vos didicistis,
to take note of those who cause dissensions and offenses contrary to the doctrine that you have learned,
and to turn away from them.
Hujuscemodi enim Christo Domino nostro non serviunt,
For ones such as these do not serve Christ our Lord,
et per dulces sermones et benedictiones seducunt corda innocentium.
and, through pleasing words and skillful speaking, they seduce the hearts of the innocent.
Vestra enim obedientia in omnem locum divulgata est.
But your obedience has been made known in every place.
And so, I rejoice in you.
Sed volo vos sapientes esse in bono,
But I want you to be wise in what is good,
and simple in what is evil.
Deus autem pacis conterat Satanam sub pedibus vestris velociter.
And may the God of peace quickly crush Satan under your feet.
Gratia Domini nostri Jesu Christi vobiscum.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
et Jason, et Sosipater cognati mei.
and Lucius and Jason and Sosipater, my kinsmen.
Saluto vos ego Tertius, qui scripsi epistolam, in Domino.
I, Tertius, who wrote this epistle, greet you in the Lord.
Gaius, my host, and the entire church,
the treasurer of the city, greets you,
Gratia Domini nostri Jesu Christi cum omnibus vobis.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.
Ei autem, qui potens est vos confirmare juxta Evangelium meum,
But to him who is able to confirm you according to my Gospel and the preaching of Jesus Christ,
et prædicationem Jesu Christi, secundum revelationem mysterii temporibus æternis taciti
in accord with the revelation of the mystery which has been hidden from time immemorial,
(quod nunc patefactum est per Scripturas prophetarum secundum præceptum æterni Dei,
(which now has been made clear through the Scriptures of the Prophets,
in accord with the precept of the eternal God,
unto the obedience of faith) which has been made known among all the Gentiles:
to him be honor and glory forever and ever.
